title: Responsible person is an inactive user
cardHint: Owned by or Managed by names a person who is no longer active, so we ask who took over. Supported by has its own card.

message.subject: Inactive {who}
message.intro: Their {role} is no longer an active user.
message.ask: Could you tell us who took over? You can {reply}, or raise the request {request}.
message.why: Without an active owner, approvals for these CIs are rejected automatically.
message.askNoRequest: Could you tell us who took over? Please {reply}, and we will update ServiceNow for you.
